verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Bayesian statistics engine for experimentation decision-making (launchdarkly-docs-34) plus a broader experimentation feature set and metric configuration (launchdarkly-docs-30, launchdarkly-docs-8, launchdarkly-docs-27). However, there's no evidence of a frequentist option or explicit variance-reduction techniques (e.g., CUPED), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the statistics engine's reliability. Missing for 10: documented frequentist alternative, documented variance-reduction methodology, independent validation of statistical results.
